title: Cinderhall/Iron Downs was referenced by ~6 different NPCs (Tamsin's quest, Warder Iss, Ironbound talk, the Regent's herald's hold list, the late-game 'Column' quest) but no room ever exposed a direct path there; extensive exploration of Thornwold's forest fringes (Spoil Verge, Deer Break, Black Thorn Stand, etc.) never surfaced an exit toward it.
